title: How Banks Really Make Money (And What They Don't Tell You)
description:
Free checking, free transfers, free debit card. So how are banks among the most profitable businesses in the world? In this video I go inside the business of banking from three angles: the 8 ways banks make money from you (the spread, low savings rates, overdraft fees, swipes), the psychology that keeps you at the wrong bank, and 10 moves to make your bank work for you.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

1:26 How we got the numbers
1:55 A short history of banking

4:42 2. Paying you almost nothing
5:59 3. Loans of every kind
7:04 4. Overdraft fees
8:40 5. Account fees
9:46 6. Your debit card swipes
10:54 7. Selling you more products
12:03 8. Float and timing
14:02 Angle 2: The Psychology
14:08 9. Inertia
15:04 10. Free feels good
16:08 11. Trust and fear
17:17 12. Convenience
18:19 13. Complexity
19:18 14. Not seeing the cost
20:13 Follow one paycheck
21:30 A quick favor
21:43 Angle 3: The Playbook
24:15 Two savers
25:37 What banks do well
26:41 What about banking apps?
27:26 What to say when you call your bank
28:24 Five red flags in your bank account
29:03 Questions people ask
31:23 Recap
32:10 What to do next

Sources:
- FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (industry net interest margin around 3%)
- FDIC, National Rates and Rate Caps (national average savings rate)
- Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, overdraft and NSF fee revenue (about $5.8 billion in 2023, down from over $12 billion in 2019)
- Federal Reserve, Regulation II debit card interchange fee cap (Durbin amendment, Dodd-Frank Act)
- Federal Reserve, FedNow Service (launched 2023)
- FDIC deposit insurance ($250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category); NCUA share insurance
- Wells Fargo unauthorized accounts enforcement actions (2016); Silicon Valley Bank failure (March 2023)
- Interest and growth figures: stated illustrative math
